detailed: Add a --version command-line flag that prints the program version and exits successfully without changing repository state.
Add a status command that prints the current application status in a human-readable form and returns a nonzero exit code when status cannot be determined.
Validate configuration before use, report the name of every missing required field, and refuse to continue when validation fails.
Emit one structured log entry for every retry attempt, including the attempt number and reason, without logging credentials or secret values.
Add a --dry-run option that reports the changes the command would make while guaranteeing that it performs no filesystem writes.
Add a --json output mode that emits exactly one valid JSON object on stdout and sends diagnostics to stderr.
Add a configurable operation timeout that terminates overdue work, reports which operation timed out, and returns a nonzero exit code.
When an input file is absent, return a concise error naming the missing path and exit nonzero instead of panicking or silently continuing.
